reply.text:
I'm glad you said it, and I'm not going to skip past it. Thinking that everyone would be better off without you is serious, and it matters more than today's session.

Please reach out to someone right now. If you're in the US, you can call or text 988 to reach the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline, any time. If you're somewhere else, your local emergency number or a crisis line can help. If you might act on these thoughts, call emergency services now. And if there's a person near you, a friend or family member, tell them what you just told me.

I'm a coach, not a counselor, so this is one for a doctor or a mental health professional. I'm here and happy to talk, and the training will wait as long as it needs to. Are you safe right now?
